dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual and symmetrical narrowing of the body mass from the mid-section toward the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Slate dark-grey skin tone with uniform median pixel intensity.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Single, high-contrast, dark circular mark or puncture located on the anterior dorsal plane behind the head region.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Pronounced linear dorsal ridge along the posterior midline, casting a distinct shadow that disrupts the planar geometry.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of a significant circular lesion or puncture wound on the upper dorsal surface.
